existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decreased GnRH pulsatility/release is the same endpoint as the decreased hypothalamic GnRH release member, and is opposite to the increased GnRH secretion member.
Decreased LH surge is the same event as 'Decreased, LH Surge from anterior pituitary', with the tissue qualifier omitted.
Decreased fecundity in general, paired with the existing decreased fecundity events, one of which is generation-specific.
Decreased COUP-TFII in stem Leydig cells is the opposite direction to the 'Increased COUP-TFII in fetal Leydig cells' member.
Inhibition of the ERG (hERG) potassium channel shares the same channel object with hERG blockade and IKr inhibition, but the processes may differ.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe impaired development, one general and one specific to the larval stage.
